mapper.sql: a.id,a.created_by,a.name,a.paper_id,a.start_at,a.end_at,a.duration_minutes,a.candidate_scope,a.status,a.allow_retake,a.max_attempts,a.shuffle_questions,a.shuffle_options,a.show_result_immediately,p.name AS paper_name,p.mode AS paper_mode,CASE WHEN p.mode='RANDOM' THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(rb.single_count+rb.multiple_count+rb.true_false_count) FROM test_paper_random_bank rb WHERE rb.paper_id=a.paper_id),0) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_paper_question pq WHERE pq.paper_id=a.paper_id) END AS question_count

mapper.update: UPDATE assessment_task SET status='ENDED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE status IN ('PUBLISHED','STARTED') AND end_at IS NOT NULL AND end_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount,COALESCE(AVG(a.score),0) AS averageScore,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS passedCount,COALESCE(MAX(a.total_score),0) AS totalScore FROM assessment_attempt a WHERE a.task_id=#{id} AND a.status='SUBMITTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assessment_attempt newer WHERE newer.participant_id=a.participant_id AND newer.attempt_no>a.attempt_no AND newer.status='SUBMITTED')

SELECT a.id,tp.name AS paperName,COALESCE(NULLIF(ap.candidate_name,''),ap.phone,'匿名考生') AS candidateName,ap.phone,(SELECT r.department_id FROM training_audience r JOIN training t ON t.id=r.training_id WHERE t.assessment_id=a.task_id AND r.phone=ap.phone) AS departmentId,(SELECT r.department_name FROM training_audience r JOIN training t ON t.id=r.training_id WHERE t.assessment_id=a.task_id AND r.phone=ap.phone) AS departmentName,a.score,a.total_score AS totalScore,a.passed,a.attempt_no AS attemptNo,a.started_at AS startedAt,a.submitted_at AS submittedAt,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assessment_attempt newer WHERE newer.participant_id=a.participant_id AND newer.attempt_no>a.attempt_no AND newer.status='SUBMITTED') THEN 'VOID' ELSE a.status END AS status FROM assessment_attempt a JOIN assessment_participant ap ON ap.id=a.participant_id JOIN assessment_task at ON at.id=a.task_id JOIN test_paper tp ON tp.id=at.paper_id WHERE a.task_id=#{id} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assessment_attempt newer WHERE newer.participant_id=a.participant_id AND newer.attempt_no>a.attempt_no AND newer.status='SUBMITTED') ORDER BY ap.id,a.attempt_no,a.idORDER BY a.id DESC

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)COUNT(DISTINCT a.participant_id) AS participantCount,COALESCE(AVG(a.score),0) AS averageScore,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),0) AS passRate,COALESCE(MAX(a.score),0) AS highestScore,COALESCE(MIN(a.score),0) AS lowestScore,COALESCE(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,a.started_at,a.submitted_at)),0) AS averageDurationSeconds,COALESCE(MAX(a.total_score),(SELECT p.total_score FROM assessment_task t JOIN test_paper p ON p.id=t.paper_id WHERE t.id=#{id}),0) AS totalScore,(SELECT p.pass_score FROM assessment_task t JOIN test_paper p ON p.id=t.paper_id WHERE t.id=#{id}) AS passScore FROM assessment_attempt a WHERE

SELECT bucket AS label,COUNT(*) AS count FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.total_score<=0 THEN '无有效满分' WHEN a.score/NULLIF(a.total_score,0)<0.6 THEN '0-59' WHEN a.score/NULLIF(a.total_score,0)<0.7 THEN '60-69' WHEN a.score/NULLIF(a.total_score,0)<0.8 THEN '70-79' WHEN a.score/NULLIF(a.total_score,0)<0.9 THEN '80-89' ELSE '90-100' END AS bucket FROM assessment_attempt a WHERE ) s GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY FIELD(bucket,'0-59','60-69','70-79','80-89','90-100')
SELECT CASE WHEN a.passed THEN '已通过' ELSE '未通过' END AS label,COUNT(*) AS count FROM assessment_attempt a WHERE GROUP BY a.passed ORDER BY a.passed DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.submitted_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS label,COUNT(*) AS count FROM assessment_attempt a WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a.submitted_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') ORDER BY MIN(a.submitted_at)

SELECT CASE qi.question_type WHEN 'SINGLE' THEN '单选题' WHEN 'MULTI' THEN '多选题' WHEN 'MULTIPLE' THEN '多选题' WHEN 'JUDGE' THEN '判断题' WHEN 'TRUE_FALSE' THEN '判断题' ELSE qi.question_type END AS type,COALESCE(SUM(aa.score),0) AS score,COALESCE(SUM(aq.score),0) AS fullScore,COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN aa.is_correct THEN 100 ELSE 0 END),0) AS correctRate FROM assessment_attempt_question aq JOIN assessment_attempt a ON a.id=aq.attempt_id JOIN question_item qi ON qi.id=aq.question_id LEFT JOIN assessment_answer aa ON aa.attempt_id=a.id AND aa.question_id=aq.question_id WHERE GROUP BY qi.question_type ORDER BY FIELD(qi.question_type,'SINGLE','MULTI','MULTIPLE','JUDGE','TRUE_FALSE')

SELECT qi.id AS questionId,qi.stem AS title,CASE qi.question_type WHEN 'SINGLE' THEN '单选题' WHEN 'MULTI' THEN '多选题' WHEN 'MULTIPLE' THEN '多选题' WHEN 'JUDGE' THEN '判断题' WHEN 'TRUE_FALSE' THEN '判断题' ELSE qi.question_type END AS type,COUNT(aq.id) AS answeredCount,COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN aa.is_correct THEN 100 ELSE 0 END),0) AS correctRate FROM assessment_attempt_question aq JOIN assessment_attempt a ON a.id=aq.attempt_id JOIN question_item qi ON qi.id=aq.question_id LEFT JOIN assessment_answer aa ON aa.attempt_id=a.id AND aa.question_id=aq.question_id WHERE GROUP BY qi.id,qi.stem,qi.question_type ORDER BY correctRate ASC,answeredCount DESC LIMIT 5
